errors.evidence: The description includes information about the method ('based on the deep-processing corpus quantitative grading method') which is not present in the figure itself. This information is likely from the paper's title or main text.
The character in the poem's title on the chart is '眺' (tiào), but the description uses the incorrect character '朓' (tiǎo).
The description adds a dot ('·') in the poem title '无题二首·二', which is not present in the original chart label ('无题二首二').
